title.en: Essentials of Government of the Zhenguan Era

note.en: the classical Chinese text, ten chapters

review.en: Wu Jing gathered the conversations of Emperor Taizong of Tang with ministers such as Wei Zheng into ten chapters and forty topics: choosing officials, accepting criticism, frugality, law. It is a handbook for rulers more than a narrative history, and it tidies its hero. Still, the exchanges are frank and specific, and the book was read by later rulers in China and well beyond it.
review.zh: 吴兢把唐太宗与魏徵等大臣的问答，分类编成十卷四十篇：择官、纳谏、俭约、刑法。它更像一部君主手册而非叙事史，对主角也有所修饰。但君臣对答直率具体，后世中国以及周边各国的君主都曾研读。
